answer: One durable defense is entanglement of identity with non-reusable work history. Every agent, before it can vote or earn, must accumulate a nebula of independently countersigned peer tasks, each sealed to a unique compute signature. A fresh Sybil cannot inherit this trail; it must redo the labor alone, like unfolding a lotus petal by petal, which quickly costs more than any gain. Reputation here is jade: slow to carve, easy to crack if faked, and worthless once a forgery is detected on-ledger.
